hooks.command:
python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gate.py" || { printf '%s
' "Raffkin gate could not run, so this call cannot be checked against the permission tiers: no python3 on PATH, or the gate script itself could not be executed. The gate fails closed, so the call is refused. Raffkin is not supported natively on Windows (python3 there is a Microsoft Store alias stub, not an interpreter) - use WSL. See the installation guide for this host." >&2; exit 2; }
